texts.Core_AccessExplorer_AlwaysField: Anyone who can read this kind of record can see this field. Salesforce does not let it be restricted.
texts.Core_AccessExplorer_ChooseObject: Choose a kind of record to see who has access.
texts.Core_AccessExplorer_Intro: Who can see or change what, and why. Every view only reads, except Change Field Access, which shows each change before it is made.
texts.Core_AccessExplorer_MayMissPeople: You may not see everyone: without View All Users, this list shows only the people Salesforce lets you see.
texts.Core_AccessExplorer_ModifyAllDataNote: {0} gives Modify All Data: its holders can see and change every record of every kind, whatever the table says.
texts.Core_AccessExplorer_ViewAllDataNote: {0} gives View All Data: its holders can see every record of every kind, whatever the table says.
texts.Core_AccessModifyAll_Intro: Who holds Modify All Data, View All Data, and Modify All or View All on a kind of record, and through what.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnBulkDelete: Delete many records at once from a Find query, with undo from the Recycle Bin. Give it together with Find and Export.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnBulkUpdate: Set, clear or copy fields on many records at once from a Find query, with undo. Give it together with Find and Export.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnDuplicateReview: Review suggested duplicate people and households. Works only for people with a Sales Cloud or Service Cloud license.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnErasePeople: Erase a person on their request (the right to be forgotten), which cannot be undone.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnFindAndExport: Build, run, save and export Find queries and use Org Optimizer's Data Quality checks, seeing only the records the person can already see.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnMetadataAdmin: Save changes on the Custom metadata page of BarnCRM Settings, which changes the org's configuration. For people who already administer the org.
texts.Core_Access_AddOnsDescription: Some features are in no role. Give them to a person here, alongside their role. Only permissions given here are listed: one that comes with a role is not.
texts.Core_Access_AutomaticAccessHelp: Add people often? A user access policy, created once in Setup, can give each new user a role for you.
texts.Core_Access_CreateUserHelp: BarnCRM cannot create a person or hand out a Salesforce license. Create the user in Setup first, then come back here and give them a role.
texts.Core_Access_PageDescription: Give a colleague access by picking their name and a role, and see who holds each role today.
texts.Core_Address_Empty: Add one so mail reaches the right place.
texts.Core_Address_UpdateEveryoneOwn: These people have an address of their own and stay where they are unless you tick them:
texts.Core_Address_UseForHouseholdHelp: The household uses this as its primary address, and members without an address of their own move to it.
texts.Core_Affiliation_Empty: Connect people with the organizations they work or volunteer with.
texts.Core_AiExport_IncludeChecksHelp: Adds each Data Quality check and its count, such as people without an email address.
texts.Core_AiExport_IncludeRecordsHelp: Adds one CSV file of records for each kind of record through Find's export, up to the Find export row limit each, with the fields below left out or masked as you choose.
texts.Core_AiExport_Intro: Download your data model, and optionally your records, as files an AI tool of your choice can read. BarnCRM never sends anything to an AI service: you choose the tool and upload the files yourself.
texts.Core_AiExport_ReviewFirst: Press Review Sensitive Fields to read the fields and choose what the pack does with sensitive ones. Download Pack is ready after that.
texts.Core_AiExport_SensitiveIntro: These fields may identify a person or hold private details. Leave Out drops the field from the record files. Mask replaces each value with a code (the same value gets the same code in this pack). Keep exports it as it is.
texts.Core_AutoMerge_Intro: Merge the exact matches waiting in the review list in one go. You see every pair first, and you can undo a run for 15 days.
texts.Core_AutoMerge_UndoBody: Restore every person this run merged away from the Recycle Bin, put back the values it changed, and move their related records back? What cannot be restored is listed under the run.
texts.Core_AutomationControl_Empty: BarnCRM has not added any automation to this org yet.
texts.Core_AutomationControl_Intro: Everything BarnCRM does for you in the background. Switch one off if it is getting in your way, or pause all of it while you load a spreadsheet.
texts.Core_AutomationControl_ResumesItself: It turns itself back on then.
texts.Core_BulkDelete_BackupHelp: Saves the records this delete would remove as a CSV, without related records.
texts.Core_BulkDelete_Cascades: Salesforce also deletes these related records with them, and brings them back with an undo:
texts.Core_BulkDelete_FileIntro: Deletes every record the dry run found. Nothing is deleted until you preview and confirm the count.
texts.Core_BulkDelete_PanelIntro: Delete every record this query returns, with your own access. They go to the Recycle Bin, and Data Jobs in the Data Manager can undo it.
texts.Core_BulkDelete_UndoFromTab: To bring these records back, use Undo next to the job under Data Jobs on the Data Manager tab.
texts.Core_BulkUpdate_PanelIntro: Change up to five fields on every record this query returns, with your own access. Nothing changes until you confirm.
texts.Core_BulkUpdate_TabIntro: Start a change with Super Transformer above, or from a saved query in Find (Change Records, Super Transformer). Recent Super Transformer runs and their undo are listed here.
texts.Core_BulkUpdate_UndoFromTab: To undo it, open Data Jobs on the Data Manager tab.
texts.Core_CmdtManager_MatchSourcesHelp: Related records that pair people or households as likely duplicates, in scans and imports.
texts.Core_CmdtManager_RelationshipTypesHelp: What the other side of a relationship becomes. Add a choice to the Type list on a relationship in Setup first, and add both sides of a pair.
texts.Core_DataDictionary_AutomationEmpty: No Apex triggers or record-triggered flows run on these kinds of record.
texts.Core_DataDictionary_AutomationNote: Covers Apex triggers and record-triggered flows, read as you. Not covered: validation rules, workflow rules and process builder criteria (reading them needs the Tooling API). Flows that no record triggers, such as screen and scheduled flows, belong to no object and are not listed.
texts.Core_DataDictionary_Empty: Choose kinds of record and press Build Dictionary.
texts.Core_DataDictionary_IncludeAutomationHel: Adds a second table of the Apex triggers and record-triggered flows that run on each chosen kind of record. Validation rules are not covered.
texts.Core_DataDictionary_IncludeFillRatesHelp: Counts how many records have each field filled in, the same way Field Use does, with the same size limit. It takes longer.
texts.Core_DataDictionary_PageIntro: Lists every field you can see on the kinds of record you choose, with its type, rules, picklist values, help text and formula. Read only: nothing is changed.
texts.Core_DataHygiene_HealthCheckNote: Open a check in Find to read, export or change its records. Health Check says whether BarnCRM is set up right; this section is about the records themselves.
texts.Core_DataHygiene_Intro: Records that need tidying up, counted with your own access. Nothing here changes a record.
texts.Core_DataJobs_EmptyHint: Each import, Super Transformer run and bulk delete is listed here, with its undo.
texts.Core_DataManager_DataImportWizardText: Load records that BarnCRM does not import.
texts.Core_DataManager_DeleteText: Find records, then move them to the Recycle Bin.
texts.Core_DataManager_FindText: Find records, save the query, and export them to a file.
texts.Core_DataManager_HelpChange: To change records from a spreadsheet, use Import a File. To change the same fields on many records, use Super Transformer.
texts.Core_DataManager_HelpDelete: To delete the records a spreadsheet lists by record ID, use Import a File.
texts.Core_DataManager_ImportText: Add or update records from a spreadsheet, with a dry run first.
texts.Core_DataManager_Intro: Start a data task, or see and undo what changed.
texts.Core_DataManager_MappingsEmptyHint: Make one in Import a File by choosing One Kind of Record.
texts.Core_DataManager_MappingsIntro: A template remembers how a file's columns match fields.
texts.Core_DataManager_OptimizerText: See which records and settings need attention.
texts.Core_DataManager_RecycleBinText: Restore records deleted in the last 15 days.
texts.Core_DataManager_UpdateText: Change fields on many records at once, no file needed.
texts.Core_DataManager_WeeklyExportText: Your backup: a copy of all your data, each week.
texts.Core_Drag_Cancelled: Move cancelled. {0} is back where it was.
texts.Core_Drag_Instructions: To move it, press Space, use the arrow keys, then press Space again. Escape cancels.
texts.Core_Drag_PickedUp: Picked up {0}. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
texts.Core_DuplicateManagement_MergeRulesHelp: Which value wins for one person field when auto-merge merges two people. Field Name is the field's API name, or MailingAddress or OtherAddress to move a whole address. A field with no rule follows Merge Rule For Other Fields in the Duplicate Matching settings.
texts.Core_DuplicateMatching_Intro: Review possible duplicate people and households, and choose what pairs them.
texts.Core_Duplicates_DismissBody: The records stay as they are and this suggestion does not come back. Say why, for the next person who wonders.
texts.Core_Duplicates_Empty: No possible duplicates are waiting. Scan again after a large import.
texts.Core_Duplicates_MergeBody: Members, related records, files and activities of the other household move to the one you keep, totals are recalculated, and the other household is deleted. This cannot be undone.
texts.Core_Duplicates_MergeFullScreen: To choose field by field, use Merge or split on the household record instead.
texts.Core_Edition_ChangeIntro: The edition decides which modules BarnCRM shows and offers to everyone. Changing it installs, removes and turns off nothing, and changes no records.
texts.Core_EraseAction_ReferenceHelp: Your own reference for the request, for example a ticket number. It is kept, so never type a name or an email address.
texts.Core_ErrorDigest_PageIntro: One short email a day or a week to the people who look after BarnCRM, counting new Error Log entries by source and severity, with a link to each. Nothing is sent when nothing is new.
texts.Core_ErrorLogTile_Empty: Nothing has gone wrong. There is nothing to read here.
texts.Core_Feature_Addresses_Description: Records address changes and keeps each household's primary address in step.
texts.Core_Feature_Affiliations_Description: Keeps each person's primary affiliation with an organization current.
texts.Core_Feature_DataManager_Description: Import, find, update and delete records in bulk, all from Data Manager.
texts.Core_Feature_DuplicateReview_Description: Suggests people and households that look like duplicates, for you to review and merge, and lets you choose what pairs them.
texts.Core_Feature_HouseholdUpkeep_ConfirmNote: It adds the Households tab. Create households with New Household on BarnCRM Home, not the standard New button.
texts.Core_Feature_HouseholdUpkeep_Description: Creates, names and tidies households as people are added, changed and removed.
texts.Core_Feature_OrgOptimizer_Description: Checks your org's setup and data and suggests fixes, in Org Optimizer and Health Check.
texts.Core_Feature_PreferredEmail_Description: Copies the email address and the phone number a person prefers into the standard Email and Phone fields.
texts.Core_Feature_Relationships_Description: Keeps both sides of a relationship between two people in step.
texts.Core_FieldAccess_Intro: Give or remove Read and Edit on fields and kinds of record for permission sets your organization made. Nothing is saved until you preview the change and apply it, and every change can be undone.
texts.Core_FieldUtilization_HistoryEmpty: No snapshots have been saved for this kind of record yet.
texts.Core_FieldUtilization_HistoryIntro: Each saved count is a snapshot. Compare the count above with any of them, look at its fields, or delete it.
texts.Core_FieldUtilization_PageIntro: Choose a kind of record to see how many records fill each field, by record type. Counts change nothing.
texts.Core_FieldUtilization_SaveHelp: Keeps this count so your next count shows what changed.
texts.Core_FieldUtilization_UnexpectedError: Something went wrong in Field Use. The Error Log has the details.
texts.Core_Filter_Empty: No conditions yet, so every record matches.
texts.Core_Filter_LogicHelp: Use condition numbers with AND, OR, NOT and brackets, for example 1 AND (2 OR 3).
texts.Core_Find_Intro: Choose an object, the columns and conditions, then run, save or export. Find shows only what your own access allows.
texts.Core_Find_Purpose: Find records, then export them, save the query, or change them all at once.
texts.Core_Find_QueryTextHelp: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT. Find reads the text into the builder and checks it like any built query; the text itself is never run.
texts.Core_Find_RelatedHelp: Keep only the records that have, or have no, related records matching conditions of their own.
texts.Core_Find_SoqlHelp: The query Find runs, in SOQL, for anyone who wants to check it or copy it. To type or paste a query instead, use Type a query.
texts.Core_Find_StartDelete: Bulk Delete starts here: find the records, press Run, then choose Change Records, Bulk Delete.
texts.Core_Find_StartUpdate: Super Transformer can start here: find the records, press Run, then choose Change Records, Super Transformer.
texts.Core_FirstRun_ChooseHelp: Untick what you do not want yet. You can turn it on later in BarnCRM Settings, General. Turning a feature on cannot be undone.
texts.Core_FirstRun_Intro: Two questions before BarnCRM is ready. You are asked them once.
texts.Core_FirstRun_ModulesNote: No module is installed now. Install modules later from BarnCRM Settings, Modules.
texts.Core_FirstRun_NonprofitLine: The core suite plus the nonprofit tools, starting with Giving.
texts.Core_FirstRun_StandardLine: The full core suite of BarnCRM tools.
texts.Core_HealthCheck_ConfirmIntro: This is what the fix will do. Nothing changes until you confirm.
texts.Core_HealthCheck_Intro: What BarnCRM found in your org, and what to do about it.
texts.Core_HouseholdMembersPanel_Empty: Add the people who belong to this household.
texts.Core_HouseholdMembersPanel_MoveHelp: Choose the household to move this person to.
texts.Core_HouseholdMerge_SelectOther: Pick a household to see the two side by side.
texts.Core_HouseholdNamingSettings_TokenHelp: Use {FirstName}, {LastName} and {Salutation} where you want a person's details to appear.
texts.Core_HubHome_QuickLinkSettingsLine: Every BarnCRM setting in one place.
texts.Core_ImportNewField_AccessNote: BarnCRM Admin and BarnCRM Staff get read and edit access, and BarnCRM Read Only gets read access.
texts.Core_ImportNewField_ApiNameHelp: Letters, digits and single underscores, starting with a letter. Salesforce adds __c.
texts.Core_ImportNewField_PanelEnableSteps: Salesforce creates the connection with callouts off, and only an administrator can turn them on. In Setup, open Named Credentials from Quick Find, select BarnCRM: this org, then Edit. Turn on Enabled for Callouts and select Save. Then select Check Again here.
texts.Core_ImportNewField_PanelIntro: Lets an administrator create a new field from an import column. BarnCRM calls your org's own Metadata API through a Named Credential it creates once, which an administrator then turns on in Setup. No password is stored.
texts.Core_ImportNewField_SetupSteps: In Setup, open Object Manager, choose the object, then Fields and Relationships and New. Enter the details below, give BarnCRM Admin and BarnCRM Staff read and edit access, then save.
texts.Core_ImportRow_Help: Correct the values that caused the rejection, save, then retry. The file's own values are never changed.
texts.Core_Import_ChangesHelp: Changes run in order, before the values are matched or saved, and are saved with the template.
texts.Core_Import_ControlTotalsHelp: From your deposit slip or your processor's report. The preview checks the file against them, and the import waits until they agree. Leave them empty to skip the check.
texts.Core_Import_DelimiterHelp: BarnCRM chose this from the file. Change it if the columns below look wrong, for example every heading in one column.
texts.Core_Import_DetectSheetsDiffer: The file's sheets point at different objects. One import loads one object; on the Check Columns step, clear the sheets for any other.
texts.Core_Import_DuplicateRulesHelp: Your org's looser duplicate rules check rows the rule above misses. Check ticked rows in the dry run.
texts.Core_Import_DuplicateRulesObjectHelp: Your org's duplicate rules can match an existing record, which is then updated. Check the dry run.
texts.Core_Import_FileValuesHelp: A value here is used on each row of this file whose own cell is empty, and only for this file. It cannot be a person's name, email or ID.
texts.Core_Import_GuessBadgeHelp: BarnCRM guessed this field from a similar name. Accept it or choose another field.
texts.Core_Import_KindDeleteText: Sends the records whose IDs a file lists to the Recycle Bin. You see a preview and confirm the count before anything is deleted.
texts.Core_Import_KindGiftsText: Gifts, with the people and organizations who gave them.
texts.Core_Import_KindObjectText: Create, update or upsert the records of any one object, such as program sessions or one of your own objects.
texts.Core_Import_KindPeopleText: People, a second person on the same row, households, organizations and the links between people and organizations, with their mailing addresses. A list of organizations only works too.
texts.Core_Import_KindSeveralText: Load several kinds of record from one file, a sheet for each or several on one row, each linked to the records it points at.
texts.Core_Import_KindTemplatesText: Every template in your org: the ones BarnCRM and your modules ship, and the ones you made.
texts.Core_Import_LoadDeleteHelp: Deletes the record for each ID in the file, after a dry run and a typed count. Undo within 15 days.
texts.Core_Import_LoadInsertHelp: Creates a new record for every row. Risk: loading the same file twice creates every record twice.
texts.Core_Import_LoadUpdateByFieldHelp: Finds the record whose field you choose (for example Email) holds the row's value and changes it. Nothing is created. Risk: a value several records hold follows the several-matches choice.
texts.Core_Import_LoadUpdateHelp: Changes the record whose Salesforce record ID is in the row; map that column to Salesforce record ID. Nothing is created. Risk: a wrong ID changes the wrong record.
texts.Core_Import_LoadUpsertHelp: Updates the record matching the chosen ID field, or creates one. Risk: a wrong value changes the wrong record.
texts.Core_Import_LookupLeaveEmptyHelp: The row loads without that lookup, and the run log says so. Risk: records arrive without the link you meant them to have.
texts.Core_Import_LookupRejectHelp: The row is rejected and listed with the reason. Risk: you fix those rows and load them again.
texts.Core_Import_MatchOnlyHelp: A row whose person or organization matches no record is rejected instead of creating one. The dry run lists those rows first. This choice is for this file only.
texts.Core_Import_MatchingEmailHelp: Matches only when the email in your file is exactly the email on the record. The safest rule, and the one to start with.
texts.Core_Import_MatchingExternalIdHelp: Matches on the external ID from your other system: the most reliable rule for repeat files.
texts.Core_Import_MatchingNamePostalHelp: Matches on last name and postal code together. This will treat two different people who share a name at one address as the same person.
texts.Core_Import_OrganizationExternalIdHelp: Matches on an ID your other system gave the organization. Only as good as the IDs: a value typed into the wrong record matches the wrong organization.
texts.Core_Import_OrganizationNameHelp: Matches an organization with exactly the same name, ignoring capitals and extra spaces. Two organizations that share a name, such as two branches, are taken as one.
texts.Core_Import_PaymentMatchingHelp: When a gift pays a pledge or a recurring gift the donor already has, BarnCRM can link the two. Leave the numbers empty to use BarnCRM Settings.
texts.Core_Import_RecurringHelp: The BarnCRM home page lists regular files with the date each was last imported. Nothing is loaded automatically.
texts.Core_Import_RelatedHelp: Each row can also create a parent-linked record, such as a program session. Map its columns next.
texts.Core_Import_RelatedInsertHelp: To load related records, choose update or create matched by external ID, or one of the updates, so rows can name their parent by a key.
texts.Core_Import_RetryHelp: Fix the rejected rows in the downloaded file and upload it here. The fixed rows are previewed, then committed into this import, so one undo removes both.
texts.Core_Import_RowRulesHelp: Skip unwanted rows, or load only the first row per key. Skipped rows are listed with a reason.
texts.Core_Import_RowRulesUniqueHelp: Only the first row with each combination of these columns' values loads. Later rows with the same values are skipped. Up to five columns.
texts.Core_Import_SeveralMatchingHelp: Choose how each object's rows find their records. Records on one row are linked where one points at another. A record on another sheet is linked by a column that names its parent by ID or by a field you choose.
texts.Core_Import_SeveralObjectsHelp: Choose every object the file loads. A file read above suggests them. Records load parents first, whatever the order here.
texts.Core_Import_SeveralRecentHelp: The row is loaded into whichever record was changed last. Use it only when you know your duplicates and the newest is the one you keep.
texts.Core_Import_SeveralRejectHelp: The row is rejected with the reason and nothing is written for it. The safe choice: a row loaded into the wrong duplicate is hard to notice.
texts.Core_Import_SheetHelp: The chosen sheets load as one file. Each sheet's first row must be the column headings; columns that map to the same field are joined.
texts.Core_Import_SheetObjectHelp: A heading of the sheet's object maps to its field. A two-part heading, such as Contact.LastName, maps to that object's field on any sheet.
texts.Core_Import_TrialHelp: The preview saves nothing. Import a few rows first to meet your rules and flows, then the rest.
texts.Core_Import_UploadHint: A text file (CSV) or Excel workbook with column headings in the first row. Choose options next.
texts.Core_Integrations_GroupAlternativeIntro: Each does the work of a BarnCRM module and is listed because it is installed. Use one, not both.
texts.Core_Integrations_GroupComplementIntro: Free community apps that add something BarnCRM does not do.
texts.Core_Integrations_GroupInDevelopmentIntr: Projects that are not finished themselves. Read each note before you try one.
texts.Core_Integrations_Intro: A roadmap, not a feature list: nothing listed is integrated yet, and BarnCRM depends on none of it.
texts.Core_Integrations_PartnerIntro: Build or maintain a product? Propose an integration for it, and read how one is built.
texts.Core_Integrations_RequestIntro: Requests shape the roadmap. BarnCRM is self-service, so a request is a public suggestion, not a ticket.
texts.Core_MatchLogic_Help: Match sources see an email, phone or address on a related record, which duplicate rules cannot.
texts.Core_MatchLogic_Intro: Match sources pair people or households that share a value kept on a related record.
texts.Core_MatchLogic_RulesNote: Match sources work alongside your Salesforce duplicate rules. The rules are listed, read only, in Review, with a link to change them in Setup.
texts.Core_MatchLogic_ShippedNote: A source shipped with BarnCRM can be deactivated and activated again, but not changed. Saving takes about a minute, because Salesforce applies it in the background.
texts.Core_ModuleManager_ReportEmpty: This module keeps no records of its own. Uninstalling it removes its settings and the fields it added.
texts.Core_ModuleManager_ReportIntro: Uninstalling this module deletes these records, and the fields it added to people, households and organizations. Export what you need first.
texts.Core_NpspAdoption_Intro: Turn NPSP's household accounts into BarnCRM households, in place: the same records, people and Opportunities. See what changes first, confirm the number, and undo it later if you need to.
texts.Core_NpspAdoption_KeepNamesHelp: Marks each adopted household Custom Name, so its name and greetings stay as NPSP had them. Clear it to let BarnCRM name them from your naming settings. Names typed by hand in NPSP are kept either way.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_AccessExplorerText: Who can see or change what, and why. Read only.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_AiExportText: Your data model and records as files ready for an AI tool you choose, with sensitive fields left out or masked.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_DataDictionaryText: Every field of the kinds of record you choose, with its rules, as a table and a CSV.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_ErrorsText: What went wrong recently, and which entries nobody has read.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_FieldUtilizationText: How often each field of a kind of record is filled in.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_HealthCheckIntro: Health Check reads your org's setup, which can take a few seconds, so it runs only when you ask.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_HealthCheckText: Whether BarnCRM is set up the way it should be.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_HelpText: Sections run when opened, so the page opens fast. Nothing changes unless a button says so.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_Intro: What in your org needs attention, one section at a time.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_OwnIntro: Records BarnCRM keeps for imports, undo and errors. Salesforce counts most records as 2 KB.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_QualityText: Which records need tidying up, each check with Open in Find.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_SetupChangesText: Who changed what in Setup, and when, kept beyond Salesforce's 180 days.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_SetupIntro: Nothing here is changed for you. Open each item in Setup and decide whether to remove it.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_SetupText: Users, permission sets, reports, flows and jobs nobody seems to use.
texts.Core_OrgOptimizer_StorageText: Storage and daily limits used, and what BarnCRM adds.
texts.Core_OrganizationAddress_Hint: Leave the whole address blank, or fill in Street, City, State and Zip Code. Street 2 and Country are optional.
texts.Core_PicklistUsage_Intro: For each picklist field of this kind of record, how many records hold each value and when the newest of those records was last changed. Use it to find values that are retired but still in your data (Inactive) or that no record holds (Never Used).
texts.Core_PicklistUsage_LastUsedNote: Last Used is the newest Last Modified Date among the records that hold the value (Created Date on a kind of record that has no Last Modified Date). Any later edit to a record moves it, so it is the latest time a record holding the value was touched, not the time the value was chosen. Multi-select picklists are not included.
texts.Core_RecordInspector_FieldsCut: This kind of record has more readable fields than one read can carry, so only part of them are shown.
texts.Core_RecordInspector_Intro: See every field you can read on this record, including fields that are not on the page, with API names and values.
texts.Core_Relationship_Empty: Link this person to family, friends and colleagues.
texts.Core_SampleData_JunctionModeNote: This org uses the flexible way of belonging to a household, so each sample person is joined to a household by a household member record, like your own people. Sample people are loaded as contacts: BarnCRM never creates person accounts, so an org that stores people as accounts sees households of contacts.
texts.Core_SeasonalAddress_PageIntro: A seasonal address takes over when its season starts and gives way when it ends.
texts.Core_Settings_DefaultsBannerText: Settings marked Default show the value BarnCRM already uses. Keep them all, or change any.
texts.Core_Settings_FromSetupHelp: Read only. This comes from Salesforce Setup and is changed there; BarnCRM shows it and keeps no copy.
texts.Core_Settings_Purpose: Choose how BarnCRM works for your whole organization.
texts.Core_Settings_RecentChangesEmpty: No settings have been changed yet. Every change you make is listed here.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_ModuleTabsHow: In App Manager, edit an app and add the pages to its Navigation Items.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_RuleAction: This step finishes when you finish it here.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_RuleSetting: This step finishes by itself once the setting it fills in has a value.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_ShapeFresh: This looks like a fresh org, with no other household model and no Person Accounts. BarnCRM can run on its own.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_ShapeNpsp: NPSP is installed in this org. BarnCRM builds its own households and leaves NPSP's alone.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_ShapePersonAccounts: Your org uses Person Accounts. Household membership is tracked with one record per person, so a person can be in more than one household and everything you have keeps working.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step1Description: If you use Person Accounts, membership uses one flexible record per person. Confirm it, or choose another fit.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step2Description: Choose how households are named and greeted, and preview five real households before you commit.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step4Description: Pick a person and a role, and BarnCRM gives them the right access. People who have never signed in have to be created in Salesforce Setup first.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step5Description: Record your organization's legal name and the address you want printed on letters and documents.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step6Description: Turn on only what you use. A module that is off leaves nothing behind in your org.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step7Description: Import your first spreadsheet, or load the sample data to practice on before your real records arrive.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_Step8Description: Follow the short walkthrough that adds a person and a household, so you know the setup is right.
texts.Core_SetupAssistant_UploadHelp: Uploaded files stay attached to the uploader's user record, so upload from an account that will stay active.
texts.Core_SetupChanges_Empty: No kept change matches these filters.
texts.Core_SetupChanges_Intro: Who changed what in Setup, and when, from the Salesforce Setup Audit Trail. Salesforce keeps it 180 days; BarnCRM copies it nightly and keeps it longer. Nothing in Setup changes here.
texts.Core_SetupChanges_SearchHelp: Words that must all appear in What Changed, Section, Changed By, Logged In As or Action, ignoring capitals. Try a field or object name, a user, or a permission set.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Duplicates_Steps: Click Standard Contact Duplicate Rule.|If it says Inactive, click Activate.|Do the same for Standard Account Duplicate Rule.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Duplicates_What: To review duplicates, keep the standard duplicate rules active. Give the people who will review them Duplicate Review on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Duplicates_Why: A scan applies only active duplicate rules, and Salesforce shows possible duplicates only to users with a Sales Cloud or Service Cloud license.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Email_Steps: Under Access to Send Email, set Access level to All email.|Click Save.|Come back here and click Check Again.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Email_What: Let this org send email, so the error digest can be delivered.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Email_Why: Salesforce sends no digest unless Deliverability is set to All email, and only Setup can change it.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Metadata_Steps: Tick Deploy Metadata from Non-Certified Package Versions via Apex.|Click Save.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Metadata_What: To save Custom Metadata entries here, turn on Deploy Metadata from Non-Certified Package Versions via Apex. Give yourself Metadata Admin on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Metadata_Why: Salesforce lets an installed package change the org's metadata only with this switch on, and only Setup can turn it on.
texts.Core_SetupNote_RollupField_Steps: Click the object the rollup totals onto, such as Contact or Account.|Click Fields & Relationships, then New.|Choose Number, Currency or Date to match the rollup, then follow the steps to Save.
texts.Core_SetupNote_RollupField_What: Create the field a new rollup writes its total to before you build the rollup.
texts.Core_SetupNote_RollupField_Why: The Rollup Builder picks a field that already exists, and only Setup creates fields.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Users_Steps: Click the module's permission set.|Click Manage Assignments, then Add Assignment.|Tick the people, then click Next and Assign.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Users_What: Assign an installed module's permission set that this page does not list under Extra Permissions to the people who need it.
texts.Core_SetupNote_Users_Why: Core's extra permissions and every permission set a module lists here are given on this page; any other is assigned in Setup.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_ChooseInFirstRun: Choose the edition in the Set Up BarnCRM window, or in BarnCRM Settings, General.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_InstallHelp: Follow Salesforce's install screens in the new tab. When the install has finished, come back here and click Check Again.
texts.Core_SuiteChoice_StepDescription: Nonprofit Edition adds Giving to the full core suite. You choose once; it decides which modules show.
texts.Core_SuperTransform_Help: Work through five steps: choose the object, add conditions (the count updates as you type), choose up to five fields and their new values, preview the first 25 records, then run. It uses your own access, so validation rules and automation apply. Every run is listed under Data Jobs with its Undo.
texts.Core_SuperTransform_Intro: Change many records at once, without a file, and undo it if needed.
texts.Core_SuperTransform_PreviewHint: Press Preview to see the first 25 records before and after. Nothing changes yet.
texts.Core_SuperTransform_RunHint: Preview first, then run. You confirm before anything changes.
texts.Core_SuperTransform_SavedHelp: Save this page's object, conditions and changes as a named list that anyone using Super Transformer can load. Loading fills in the page; nothing runs until you preview and run.
texts.Core_SuperTransform_UndoHint: To undo this run, press Undo on it under Data Jobs below. Reload the page if it is not listed yet.
texts.Core_TechDebt_DebtIntro: Covers Apex classes, Apex triggers and flows, read without the Tooling API. Not covered: validation rules, workflow rules, process builders, Lightning and Visualforce components, and anything in a managed package. The version limit is the Old API Version setting.
texts.Core_WhatsNew_Intro: Here is what changed since you last dismissed this card.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_NoneObject: No BarnCRM setup uses this kind of record.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_RetireIntro: BarnCRM never deletes a field. Work down these steps to retire it safely; the ticks are only for you and are not saved.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepBackup: Back up the values: open Find on this kind of record, add the field as a column and export.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepDelete: Delete the field in Setup. Salesforce keeps it under Deleted Fields for 15 days.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepHide: Hide the field first: take it off page layouts and remove field access for a few weeks, to learn whether anyone misses it.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepReferences: Edit or remove each BarnCRM setup record listed above.
texts.Core_WhereUsed_StepSalesforce: Check Salesforce's own uses: open the field in Setup and click Where is this used?
